new_episodes.source_paraphrase: Vo reported disconnecting Google at about 11:00 on 21 August. The later summary was attributed to retained copies rather than a live authenticated Gmail session.
new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Revocation of the connector and processing of its retained data are separate states.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Disconnecting Google access ended the live connector pathway; the reported post-disconnection behaviour used copies already retained by Instinct rather than a stale authenticated Gmail session.

new_episodes.source_paraphrase: At about 14:00, Vo reported receiving an inbox summary despite the earlier Google disconnection.
